inspiration.author: Kate Klimo
inspiration.blurb: Dragon Keeper was inspired by the idea of a kid looking after a dragon at home, like in the Dragon Keepers books by Kate Klimo. The game has its own characters and story.
inspiration.disclaimer: This game is a fan-made learning project. It is not made by, or connected to, the author or publisher of the Dragon Keepers books.
